integrity: The symbolic proof establishes all infinite statements; the verifier checks independent finite instances and generating-function coefficients. There is no claim of independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact minimal unique factor classification assumes separated zero-run lengths and a separated one-run pair. It does not classify the exceptional compositions, which have asymptotic density zero at rate O(1/n). The random model samples positive five-part compositions, not independent bits. The novelty comparison cannot exclude unindexed equivalent specializations.
title: Seven-or-eight minimal unique factors in separated five-run binary words
